## 2. Compare (same commands as baseline)

| Command | Expected difference (table 1) | Observed diff | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/projectstore:doctor` | + `surface` issue (stale launcher, pre-provenance); + `mcp` info; exit 1 in the Bash result | | |

| `/projectstore:search` | grouped literal search, per-file cap | | |
| every other command | identical output | | |

| second `/projectstore:doctor` | clean but for the `mcp` info; startup line on next session: no offer | | |
| second bound project | the same one `--fix` — record the per-project cost | | |
